title: Nvidia's NVentures joins TerraPower's $650M fundraise

sources.quote: This fundraise was comprised of both new investors, including NVentures, the venture capital arm of NVIDIA, and current investors, including TerraPower-founder Bill Gates and HD Hyundai, an industry leader in shipbuilding.

explain: Nvidia's venture arm invested in Bill Gates-founded TerraPower as part of a $650 million round to build its first Natrium reactor in Kemmerer, Wyoming. Nvidia's own amount was not disclosed.
